description:
A REORDER ALSO REQUIRES A NEW VISUAL PREVIEW AND BUYER CONFIRMATION.

    First call preview_print_order with reorder_of and any desired changes, show every
    image/options/price to the buyer, and obtain confirmation. Then call this with
    preview_id, preview_version and buyer_confirmed=true, without option overrides.
    Without a preview this returns a preview only; it never creates an order.

    In preview_print_order, quantity means complete sets for multi-part reorders;
    material/color overrides apply to every part. Omit overrides to preserve choices.
    Prices are recalculated. The previous order's geometry is reused without requesting
    a new upload. Shipping/contact details are never copied from the previous order;
    confirm the new address with the buyer. Orders cancelled by HardCopy Labs or still
    awaiting payment cannot be reordered. Returns a new job ID, total and payment link
    when payment is required, only after the new preview is confirmed.

buyer_confirmed.description: True ONLY after showing every preview image/options/price and receiving explicit buyer confirmation. Not proof of human viewing.
buyer_confirmed.title: Buyer Confirmed

color.description: Filament color. Leave empty to keep the earlier order's color.
color.title: Color

contact_email.description: The buyer's email, for the receipt and order updates. Not copied from the earlier order.
contact_email.title: Contact Email

job_id.description: The id of the earlier order to copy, like hc-1a2b3c4d.
job_id.title: Job Id

material.description: pla or petg. Leave empty to keep the earlier order's material.
material.title: Material

preview_id.description: The id returned by preview_print_order for the images shown to the buyer.
preview_id.title: Preview Id

preview_version.description: The exact preview version the buyer confirmed; changes require a new preview.
preview_version.title: Preview Version

quantity.description: How many identical copies. Capped by print time, not a flat number; the totals cover all of them.
quantity.title: Quantity

ship_to.description: Recipient's full name and US street address, including city, state and ZIP. Not copied from the earlier order. We ship within the United States only.
ship_to.title: Ship To

name: reorder_print_job
title: Reorder a past print
